title: Train tw_master_v2 (H200, 4500 steps)
owner_gate: M3: owner clicks gpu_rent (H200) and ONE gpu_rental_exec (lora-v2/MORNING.md); before that gpu_my to avoid touching someone else's box

budget.hard_stop_rule: nominal + 15%: above that the run stops and the owner is asked
budget.hard_stop_override_reason: measured fork of the GPU session cost is 160-270 cr (v1 cost 248 cr); 270 is the upper end, not nominal + 15%
assumptions: fork 160-270 cr; v1 cost 248 cr for the whole session; 215 is the middle
134 cr/h H200; expected 70-100 min training + eval

candidates_policy: no candidates: one training run; checkpoints s3000/s4000/final are evaluated, 5 tags x 80 images

criteria: G3 palette via image_stats.py (pink/lavender share and saturation near base model)
G4 no garbled text in UI outputs (OCR gate)
pick s3000 or s4000; later steps over-bake (v1 lesson)

pilot.go_rule: no pilot; the 5% rule does not apply to a training job; the 270 cr hard stop is the upper end of the measured fork

tool_note: GPU job, not an image prompt. The prepared kit (dataset on CloudFront, launch_v2.sh, EXEC_COMMAND_V2.txt, MORNING.md) lives in the research workspace lora-v2/, not in this repo. Upload slots in the exec command expire 24 h after 2026-11-27 23:13 UTC.
guards: Before each launch: estimate_*_cost -> quote_ref; abort the task when the quote is above max_credits.
Actual spend goes to design/art_batches/SPEND_LOG.csv; more than 15% over the batch nominal = stop and ask the owner.
Every output lands in assets/incoming, then double anatomy audit -> metadata scrub -> watermark pass -> manifest `approve`.
Prompts are untested: run the pilot tasks first (2-3 frames), look at them, only then release the rest.

tasks.prompt: Launch tw_master_v2 training with lora-v2/EXEC_COMMAND_V2.txt via ONE gpu_rental_exec: rank 128, 4500 steps, trigger 'twmaster2 style', dataset 348 images used. Poll gpu_rental_logs every 10 minutes for DONE_V2 / FAILED_V2, hard deadline 150 minutes, then gpu_rental_stop. Eval pack: 5 tags x 80 images.
